meta.title: Withdraw Intake Request: refused for a user without the Requester / End User role
gaps: Open and withdraw a pending intake request using the Withdraw Intake Request action
Sign in as a user without the Requester / End User role and verify the action is refused or absent
Repeat the withdrawal as a Requester / End User and verify the action is available
Verify the tenant is on the Growth plan when no tenant identifier is provided
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open and withdraw a pending intake request using the Withdraw Intake Request action; Sign in as a user without the Requester / End User role and verify the action is refused or absent; Repeat the withdrawal as a Requester / End User and verify the action is available; Verify the tenant is on the Growth plan when no tenant identifier is provided

args.need: sign in as the user without the Requester / End User role, attempt to withdraw a pending intake request, then repeat as a Requester / End User and record whether the action is refused or available

steps.note: No catalog step can navigate intake requests, switch to the specified personas, or perform the role-based withdrawal comparison.
Confirm the session remains usable after the tester completes the unavailable role-based workflow; this does not assert the intake permission outcome.
